newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys May diesel, mogas from Glencore.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys May diesel, mogas from Glencore.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender diesel at 38 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes and gasoline at a $1.85-premium from Swiss trader Glencore, a CPC source said on Monday.

The combination cargo, comprising 230,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 40,000 barrels of 95-octane leaded gasoline, is for May 21-22 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo.
The source said CPC would decide by Thursday on another tender for end-May/early June delivery.
If the tender was issued, it would close by May 14, the source said.
